buildNotes:
This build includes the following changes:
- School tracker: no default materials or recommenders on new schools
- Delete all materials/recommenders individually or via Clear all (with loader)
- Fixed empty checklist persistence and blur/delete race on tracker saves
- SOP sync only marks Personal Statement done when that row exists
- Hyperdrive local URL fix for passwordless Postgres during cf:build/cf:deploy
- Unit tests for school tracker normalize/serialize behavior
